_about: Texas GMA Desired Future Conditions (DFC) ETL transforms. Covers unit conversions, format transforms, budget extraction, and compliance-check steps for evaluating MODFLOW and observational groundwater data against TWDB 2021 joint-planning DFC targets. Key metrics across the 16 GMAs: drawdown (feet, most GMAs), volume in storage remaining (percent, GMA 1 Ogallala), saturated thickness (percent/feet, GMAs 12–13), spring flow (cfs/mgd, GMAs 7/10), stream flow (acre-feet/month, GMA 8 Edwards BFZ), potentiometric surface drawdown (feet, GMA 10 saline Edwards). Source: https://www.twdb.texas.gov/groundwater/dfc/2021jointplanning.asp

_cbc_formats._about: Version-specific CBC (cell-by-cell budget) format tags. Each MODFLOW executable writes a slightly different binary layout; distinct format IDs let BFS route to the correct extraction spec and trace back to the originating Tapis app.

_hds_formats._about: Version-specific HDS (binary head) format tags for future/raw MODFLOW head sources. The bundled DFC demo now uses the georeferenced CKAN GeoTIFF head raster directly; HDS sources still route through hds-to-geotiff when supplied.

transform_specs.name: head-ft-to-m
transform_specs.description: Convert hydraulic head (or drawdown) from feet to metres.

transform_specs.name: head-m-to-ft
transform_specs.description: Convert hydraulic head (or drawdown) from metres to feet.

transform_specs.name: sat-thickness-m-to-ft
transform_specs.description: Convert aquifer saturated thickness from metres to feet. GMA 12/13 DFC targets are specified in feet.

transform_specs.name: sat-thickness-ft-to-m
transform_specs.description: Convert aquifer saturated thickness from feet to metres.

transform_specs.name: flow-cfs-to-m3s
transform_specs.description: Convert spring discharge from cfs to m3s. GMA 7 spring-flow DFCs: Las Moras Springs 23.9 cfs; GMA 10 Barton Springs 49.7 cfs.

transform_specs.name: flow-m3s-to-cfs
transform_specs.description: Convert spring discharge from m3s to cfs.

transform_specs.name: flow-mgd-to-m3s
transform_specs.description: Convert spring discharge from mgd to m3s. GMA 7 Val Verde: maintain 73–75 mgd at San Felipe Springs.

transform_specs.name: flow-m3s-to-mgd
transform_specs.description: Convert spring discharge from m3s to mgd.

transform_specs.name: flow-cfs-to-af-month
transform_specs.description: Convert stream flow from cfs to acre-feet per month. GMA 8 Edwards BFZ DFC targets are in af/month.

transform_specs.name: flow-af-month-to-cfs
transform_specs.description: Convert stream flow from acre-feet per month to cfs.

transform_specs.name: flow-m3s-to-af-month
transform_specs.description: Convert stream flow from m3s to acre-feet per month. Used when MODFLOW budget output (SI units) feeds a GMA 8 af/month DFC target.

transform_specs.name: flow-af-month-to-m3s
transform_specs.description: Convert stream flow from acre-feet per month to m3s.

transform_specs.name: hds-to-geotiff
transform_specs.description: Convert a MODFLOW 6 binary head file (.hds) to a GeoTIFF raster for a specified layer/stress-period. Calls geo_actor which wraps flopy.

transform_specs.name: hds-mfusg-to-geotiff
transform_specs.description: Convert a MODFLOW-USG binary head file to a GeoTIFF. USG uses an unstructured grid; geo_actor uses flopy's HeadFile reader with CLN support.

transform_specs.name: hds-mf2000-to-geotiff
transform_specs.description: Convert a MODFLOW-2000 binary head file to a GeoTIFF raster.

transform_specs.name: hds-mf96-to-geotiff
transform_specs.description: Convert a MODFLOW-96 binary head file to a GeoTIFF raster.

transform_specs.name: head-point-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract hydraulic head at a monitoring well (lat/lon) from a head GeoTIFF. Produces a scalar-json for point-based DFC targets such as GMA 10 well threshold (1,184 ft MSL).

transform_specs.name: head-gma-average
transform_specs.description: Clip a head GeoTIFF (in feet) to a GMA boundary and compute the spatial average. Output gma-scalar: {gma_id, average_value_ft, unit, n_cells, aquifer}.

transform_specs.name: gma-boundary-query
transform_specs.description: Query the TWDB GMA ArcGIS layer for a single Groundwater Management Area and return GeoJSON. This is a Tapis-hosted function task used to materialize the boundary passed into model-output DFC calculations.

transform_specs.name: gcd-boundary-query
transform_specs.description: Query the TWDB Groundwater Conservation District ArcGIS layer for one district and return GeoJSON for DFC area construction.

transform_specs.name: county-boundary-query
transform_specs.description: Query the TWDB Texas county ArcGIS layer for one county and return GeoJSON for DFC area construction.

transform_specs.name: gma-shapefile-boundary-normalize
transform_specs.description: Normalize the TWDB GMA shapefile ZIP to EPSG:4326 GeoJSON through the geo_actor.

transform_specs.name: gcd-shapefile-boundary-normalize
transform_specs.description: Normalize the TWDB Groundwater Conservation District shapefile ZIP to EPSG:4326 GeoJSON through the geo_actor.

transform_specs.name: county-shapefile-boundary-normalize
transform_specs.description: Normalize a Texas county shapefile ZIP to EPSG:4326 GeoJSON through the geo_actor.

transform_specs.name: dfc-gma-county-area-intersect
transform_specs.description: Intersect a GMA boundary and county boundary to derive a DFC planning area GeoJSON used for model-output clipping and aggregation.

transform_specs.name: dfc-gma-gcd-area-intersect
transform_specs.description: Intersect a GMA boundary and Groundwater Conservation District boundary to derive a DFC planning area GeoJSON used for model-output clipping and aggregation.

transform_specs.name: gma-dfc-compliance
transform_specs.description: Check simulated GMA-average head/drawdown against TWDB 2021 DFC targets. Multi-input: current head scalar + baseline head scalar + DFC targets CSV. Output: dfc-compliance-report {gma_id, observed_drawdown_ft, dfc_target_ft, status, margin_ft}.

transform_specs.name: spring-dfc-compliance
transform_specs.description: Check simulated GMA spring discharge against TWDB 2021 DFC spring-flow targets (GMAs 7, 10). Input: simulated spring flow GMA scalar (m3s) + DFC targets CSV. Output: dfc-compliance-report {gma_id, observed_flow_m3s, dfc_target_m3s, status, margin_m3s}.

transform_specs.name: stream-dfc-compliance
transform_specs.description: Check simulated GMA stream flow against TWDB 2021 DFC stream-flow targets (GMA 8 Edwards BFZ). Input: simulated river flow GMA scalar (m3s) + DFC targets CSV. Output: dfc-compliance-report.

transform_specs.name: satthk-dfc-compliance
transform_specs.description: Check simulated GMA saturated thickness against TWDB 2021 DFC saturated-thickness targets (GMAs 12, 13). Output: dfc-compliance-report.

transform_specs._comment: ── MODFLOW CBC budget extract specs (drain/spring, river/stream, sat thickness) ──────────────
transform_specs._comment2: Each spec is version-specific so BFS can trace the chain back to the originating Tapis app.
transform_specs._comment3: format: cbc-mf6 = MODFLOW 6 CBC; cbc-mfusg = MODFLOW-USG; cbc-mf2000 = MODFLOW-2000; cbc-mf96 = MODFLOW-96.

transform_specs.name: modflow6-drain-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract total drain-package discharge (DRN budget) from a MODFLOW 6 cell-by-cell budget file, clip to GMA boundary, and sum to a GMA scalar in m3s. DRN flows represent spring discharge in most Texas karst aquifer models. Calls geo_actor /extract-budget-gma with package=DRN.

transform_specs.name: modflow-usg-drain-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract drain-package discharge from a MODFLOW-USG cell-by-cell budget, clip to GMA, sum to scalar m3s. MODFLOW-USG CBC uses unstructured-grid binary layout; geo_actor uses flopy's CellBudgetFile with CLN support.

transform_specs.name: modflow-2000-drain-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract drain-package discharge from a MODFLOW-2000 cell-by-cell budget, clip to GMA, sum to scalar m3s.

transform_specs.name: modflow-96-drain-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract drain-package discharge from a MODFLOW-96 cell-by-cell budget, clip to GMA, sum to scalar m3s.

transform_specs.name: modflow6-river-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract river-package (RIV) leakage from a MODFLOW 6 cell-by-cell budget, clip to GMA, sum to scalar m3s. RIV leakage represents baseflow / stream–aquifer exchange. Used for GMA 8 Edwards BFZ stream-flow DFC targets.

transform_specs.name: modflow-usg-river-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract river-package leakage from a MODFLOW-USG cell-by-cell budget, clip to GMA, sum to scalar m3s.

transform_specs.name: modflow-2000-river-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract river-package leakage from a MODFLOW-2000 cell-by-cell budget, clip to GMA, sum to scalar m3s.

transform_specs.name: modflow-96-river-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Extract river-package leakage from a MODFLOW-96 cell-by-cell budget, clip to GMA, sum to scalar m3s.

transform_specs.name: modflow6-satthk-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Compute GMA-average saturated thickness from a MODFLOW 6 head file. geo_actor reads the DIS/DISV package alongside the HDS to compute sat_thickness = head − bottom_elev per cell, clips to GMA boundary, returns spatial average in feet. GMA 12/13 DFC targets are percent of original saturated thickness.

transform_specs.name: modflow-usg-satthk-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Compute GMA-average saturated thickness from a MODFLOW-USG head file.

transform_specs.name: modflow-2000-satthk-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Compute GMA-average saturated thickness from a MODFLOW-2000 head file.

transform_specs.name: modflow-96-satthk-gma-extract
transform_specs.description: Compute GMA-average saturated thickness from a MODFLOW-96 head file.
